title: A learning path for algorithms
summary: Progress from learning the basics to practicing problems and building a knowledge framework, deepening understanding through regular review and active summarization.
description: Three stages are arranged from left to right in the figure, and the table below lists each stage's goal, study material, and supporting method. Beneath Stages 2 and 3, method boxes point upward to their respective stages with arrows; Stage 1 has no separate method box.

frames.title: A learning path for algorithms
frames.explanation: A one-way arrow leads from Stage 1 to Stage 2, while two arrows in opposite directions connect Stage 2 and Stage 3. After entering Stage 3, you can return to Stage 2 to practice more problems so that hands-on problem solving and organizing knowledge reinforce each other.

tables.caption: Three learning stages and supporting methods
rows: No separate method shown in the figure
Review regularly: re-solve the same problem at intervals for lasting recall and deeper understanding
Algorithm articles, problem-solving frameworks, and algorithm textbooks
Summarize what you learn: organize the material, identify patterns, and build a complete knowledge framework
